The HVAC Technician is responsible for the installation, operation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of the hotel's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration systems to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation.
Carry out daily inspections of HVAC and refrigeration equipment and systems.
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on air conditioning and ventilation systems.

Monitor and maintain proper temperature and humidity levels throughout the hotel.

Identify and repair refrigerant leaks and other system faults.

Respond promptly to maintenance requests and HVAC breakdowns, particularly in guest rooms and critical hotel areas.

Assist with the installation, testing, and commissioning of new HVAC equipment.
Maintain accurate records of preventive maintenance, repairs, inspections, and equipment performance.
Ensure all tools, equipment, and spare parts are properly maintained and safely stored.
Coordinate with other Engineering team members and departments to minimize disruption to hotel operations.
Report major equipment faults, recurring problems, and required spare parts to the Engineering Supervisor or Chief Engineer.
Follow all hotel safety, environmental, and energy-conservation procedures.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of refrigerants and other technical materials in accordance with applicable regulations.
Maintain a clean and safe working environment.
Assist other Engineering team members with general maintenance duties when required.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Chief Engineer or Engineering management.

The ISO & ICV Executive plays a key role in maintaining the organization's ISO management systems and ICV requirements. This position ensures that all documentation, processes, records, and supporting evidence are up-to-date and audit-ready. Working closely with Finance and other departments, the ISO & ICV Executive monitors compliance, coordinates audits, documents processes, and follows up on corrective actions. The role supports management in enhancing internal controls, improving processes, and maintaining records necessary for certification, audit, and ICV submissions, contributing to the overall governance and compliance framework of the organization.
q: Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and internal audit methodology.
Proficiency in SOP and process documentation and records control.
Experience with ICV requirements and supporting documentation.
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
What Qualifies You For The Role
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Quality Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor training.
3-5 years of relevant experience in ISO, quality systems, internal controls, audit, finance compliance, or ICV-related activities.
Experience in a multi-department organization within the automotive, trading, distribution, or service industry.
